dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: I'm here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Mhm.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: I mean, uh... Everything here is really nice. And I'm used to it now, so there's no need to worry about me.

choices.text: It's okay. You don't have to be so polite.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Sorry...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: I'm just worried that if I just say everything on my mind, I might cause unnecessary misunderstandings.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: ...Alright, then in that case, I'll do as you ask...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: To tell you the truth, I—I'm actually a little homesick.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Even though this place is really comfortable, and the environment here is flawless, I just... can't seem to get used to life here.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: This is nobody's problem but my own, so... Please don't think I'm upset with you, or unsatisfied about anything in this place.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: ...I hope you can forgive me.

choices.text: You can tell me how you really feel.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Heh... Are you really sure about that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Mhm... Please go ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't we talk about Pers?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: ...Ah, thank you for remembering its name.

choices.text: Is there a story behind Pers's name?

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: To explain it... I'll need to tell you a really, really old story I once read in a picture book.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ooh, I'm listening!

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Mhm... So once upon a time, in a faraway seaside town, there lived a black and white bird.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Since birth, it spoke with a stutter, walked with a wobble, and was unable to fly, so it was always bullied by the other birds.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Until one day, greedy pirates stole a jewel-studded diadem from the underwater palace...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: In a flash, lightning and thunder engulfed the sea, and a tsunami rose from the depths, threatening to wipe out the entire town...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: The black-and-white bird tried to leap upwards, but it still couldn't fly... In its recklessness, it crashed against the mast and sank into the ocean alongside the wrecked ship.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: The seabirds flying overhead thought it would drown right then and there, but to their surprise, it began to swim like the swiftest of fish!

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: It swam and swam, until its strength finally gave out. It restored the diadem to its rightful place underwater, and immediately, the storms died down, and it was as if nothing bad had ever happened.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: As you've probably guessed by now... The bird in the story was named Pers. It was a penguin that came to town by accident.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: I've always admired the Pers in the story, but after reading it, what struck me the most was... its loneliness.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: So, I decided to stick close and hug Pers, so we can keep each other warm...

choices.text: Ah, I didn't know you were friends with a hero!

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: ...Heh, you're right.

choices.text: Why does Pers look the way it does?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Hmm... Could I trouble you to accompany me to a few places when you're free?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: I'd like to visit Lepaute Horlogerie, Beaumont Workshop, and the Vasari Passage.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Mhm... I'd like to take a look at their clockwork crafts, as well as the variety of small mechanisms they usually have to offer.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: I'm a regular of Leschots', but whenever I pass by the other shops, I can't help but be curious...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: What lies hidden deep within those shops? What if there's something there that's both original and exquisitely designed?

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: What I wouldn't give to be able to see everything for myself! If only... *sigh*

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: See, I'm... not very good at dealing with people, and if I spent a lot of time gawking at the wares without paying a single coin, I'm sure the shopkeepers would get mad at me.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: So, if you could step in at that point, and help me...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Yeah... Something like that. I know it might be awkward, but...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: I'll pay you back, I swear! As long as it's something I can do...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No problem.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Ahh, thank you so much! I'm... not dreaming, am I?

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Eh!? No, no, of course not! That's not what I meant at all...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Just a few words of explanation... should be enough.

choices.text: Is there anything in particular you're interested in?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Freminet.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Good morning.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: I'm... just going to stay here if you don't have any special assignments.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Freminet.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: "May your dreams be as dazzling as the starry night above the ocean, and your dreamless nights be naught but filled with serene respite."

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: These buildings and those spherical lamps — they use this style in Merusea Village, don't they? I recognize them from a picture album.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Legends say that the home of the Melusines is a secluded little village deep under the water, far away from the rest of the world — the kind of village you read about in fairytales. But I've always believed it's real.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Um... But please don't tell anyone else I said that. Most people would probably think I'm just being childish...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: With storage heaters like this, adding an extra layer of heating elements makes them more durable than is usually advertized.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: And the motor in this kind of fan is always running at critical velocity, which poses a safety issue...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: ...Sorry! I tend to get carried away when I start talking about this kind of stuff. Um, with your permission, though, I could definitely tweak them so they run a lot better! At least, I—I think I could...
